body.summary: Re-validate after code review round 1 (222cc3f0): testsReaching entries now carry the caller's test file (`<file>#<caller>`, grounding.ts) and the coverage rule judges a reaching entry by its test file's latest run in the test record, never by matching a caller name to a title (round 1's 6 MEDs came from helper names matched against titles). New case: buildCoveragePrompt join test; grounding.test.ts updated for the entry format. Two falsifying mutations each fail them. Earlier t2 behaviour (latest run by ranAt, barriers, BUILD per-task passed) unchanged; the named t2 test still passes.
